name: quran.ai
description: Turn Claude into your AI-powered Quran study companion — trace themes across all 114 surahs, compare how classical and modern scholars interpret the same verse, unpack the depth and precision behind the Quran's eloquence, and contextualize difficult passages with real, authentic tafsir commentary. All data sourced from quran.com, so every verse, scholarly opinion, interpretation, and linguistic detail the AI cites is verified — not guessed from training data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add quran.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add quran.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.quran.ai/.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the quran.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: quran.ai lists 14 MCP tools, including fetch_grounding_rules, fetch_skill_guide, fetch_quran, search_quran, fetch_translation, search_translation, fetch_tafsir, search_tafsir, list_editions, fetch_quran_metadata, fetch_word_morphology, and fetch_word_paradigm.
quran.ai does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
quran.ai is developed by quran.ai — by Quran Foundation (quran.com). It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
